code: slen = decode_record(ctx, cursor, attr_dns_question, p, end - p, packet_ctx, packet + 4);
note: The DNS header qdcount field from the input packet controls how many question records are decoded.

code: slen = fr_struct_from_network(ctx, cursor, attr, p, end - p, true, packet_ctx, decode_value_trampoline, NULL);
note: The question body pointer and remaining packet length are passed to the structured decoder.

code: slen = fr_dns_label_uncompressed_length(packet_ctx->packet, data, data + data_len - packet_ctx->packet, &next, packet_ctx->lb);
note: For a non-array DNS label, the buffer length passed to the label verifier is computed as packet-relative total length instead of bytes remaining from data, making the allowed end extend past the input allocation.
The oversized end pointer causes the truncation check for the input-controlled label length byte to pass even though the actual packet has no label content byte.
q points one byte beyond the real input buffer, so checking the first label character performs the heap-buffer-overflow read.
